1b1a7634-b8a5-43ee-97d8-9786cbc7ba2b.name: Brainstorm
rules: Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

76e67200-b18e-4c37-8d1c-a34b063c8695.name: Opt
rules:
Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
Draw a card.

b4cedfc1-d53d-453d-8fc1-5e99079c045d.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
